profile.katakana: アシシュ・チョウドリー
profile.about: Software developer from Odisha, India, working where IoT, web and design meet. By day I build core features at Alphaion; after hours I wire up robots, design interfaces and geek out over F1, Hot Wheels, Marvel, BattleBots, comics and memes. Basically a kid with a soldering iron and a race number.

points: Develop and maintain core features for Alphaion's web and internal applications.
Integrate APIs and keep communication between system modules smooth; fix bugs and improve stability.
Build landing pages, dashboards and automation workflows with product, design and marketing teams.
Drive product metrics through data-driven improvements, code reviews and innovation sprints.
Helped develop and optimize core application modules to improve performance.
Fixed bugs, integrated APIs and improved workflow efficiency with the dev team.
Supported testing, documentation and deployment for smooth delivery.
Led the build of a Smart Networking Email Transmission System — 30% better interdepartmental communication.
Worked in a 5-member cross-functional team to analyse bottlenecks and design the solution.
Implemented secure data-handling protocols compliant with industry standards.
